t=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$t/src" "$t/dest" && echo a > "$t/src/f" \
&& for s in 20260101-010000 20260102-010000 20260103-010000; do BACKUP_STAMP=$s bash backup.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name "my backup" "$t/src" >/dev/null; done \
&& echo "--- rotate dry-run, keep 1:" && bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest="$t/dest" --name="my backup" --keep=1 --dry-run \
&& echo "--- verify --name filter:" && bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name "my backup" \
&& echo "--- help exits 0:" && bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null && bash verify.sh -h >/dev/null && echo yes \
&& echo "--- unknown option exits 1:" && rc=0; bash verify.sh --dest "$t/dest" --bogus >/dev/null 2>&1 || rc=$?; echo "rc=$rc" \
&& rc=0; bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name x --keep 0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || rc=$?; echo "keep0 rc=$rc" \
&& rc=0; bash verify.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name "nosuch" >/dev/null 2>&1 || rc=$?; echo "no-match rc=$rc" \
; rm -rf "$t"
